idea.title: Your first reply to an Instagram property enquiry
idea.angle: A copy-paste first reply that answers and asks the right next question
idea.hook: Do this before you reply to your next 'Price?' DM

slides.heading: Your **First Reply** Wins The Buyer
slides.body: Copy this the next time someone DMs 'Price?'

slides.heading: Reply **Fast**
slides.body: Short and quick beats long and late. They're messaging other agents too.

slides.heading: Answer **First**
slides.body: Give the price straight away. Hiding it makes buyers scroll on.

slides.heading: Ask **One** Question
slides.body: Not five. One easy question keeps the chat moving.

slides.heading: Other **Next Questions**
bullets: When do you want to move in?
Is this to rent or buy?

caption:
Your first reply to a 'Price?' DM decides if the buyer stays.

Reply fast, even if it's short.
Answer the question they asked. Give the price.
Then ask ONE easy next question, like weekday or Saturday viewing.
That one question turns a price check into a booked viewing.

idea.title: Why plug-and-play chatbots annoy buyers
idea.angle: Generic bots vs a properly built assistant that knows your listings
idea.hook: Why buyers hate your chatbot (and what a well-built one does instead)

slides.heading: Why Buyers **Hate** Your Chatbot
slides.body: The AI isn't the problem. The setup is.

slides.heading: What Buyers **Actually** Want
bullets: A straight answer to 'Is it available?'

slides.heading: Feed It **Your Listings**
slides.body: Real prices, areas and availability. Not guesses.

slides.heading: Ask Like **An Agent**
slides.body: Budget, area, move-in date. One question at a time, like you would on WhatsApp.

slides.heading: Book **The Viewing**
slides.body: The goal is a date in your diary, not a long chat.

slides.heading: Hand Over **To You**
slides.body: Serious buyer or tricky question? It passes the chat to a real person.

caption:
Buyers don't hate chatbots. They hate badly built ones.

A plug-and-play bot doesn't know your listings, your prices or your areas.
A proper assistant is fed your real listings and FAQs.
It asks budget, area and move-in date, one question at a time.
It books the viewing, then hands serious buyers to you.
The AI isn't smart on its own. The system around it is.

idea.title: Every missed message is a missed commission
idea.angle: A fill-in-your-own-numbers calculation of what slow replies cost (no invented stats)
idea.hook: Work out what slow replies really cost you, in 4 quick steps

slides.heading: What Slow Replies **Cost** You
slides.body: 4 quick steps. Use your own numbers.

slides.heading: Count **Enquiries**
slides.body: WhatsApp, DMs, calls. Say you get 40 a month. Write yours down.

slides.heading: Count The **Missed** Ones
slides.body: Slow replies and no follow-up. Be honest. Say 10.

slides.heading: Know Your **Close Rate**
slides.body: Out of 10 good leads, how many usually rent or buy? Say 1.

slides.heading: Add Your **Commission**
slides.body: Your average commission per deal, in cedis or naira.

slides.heading: Your **Monthly** Leak
bullets: Missed leads x close rate x commission
Say 10 missed, 1 in 10 close: one deal gone

caption:
Every missed message is a missed commission. Here's how to put a number on it.

Count your monthly enquiries.
Count the ones that got a slow reply or no follow-up.
Multiply by your close rate.
Multiply by your average commission in cedis or naira.
That's what your leak costs you every month.

idea.title: A weekend auto-reply that doesn't sound like a robot
idea.angle: Template for weekend enquiries that still books the viewing
idea.hook: A weekend auto-reply that still books viewings

slides.heading: Auto-Replies That Still **Book** Viewings
slides.body: Off on Sunday? Your reply doesn't have to be.

slides.heading: Sound **Like You**
slides.body: Use your name and a warm hello. Not 'Your message has been received.'

slides.heading: Say When **You're Back**
slides.body: 'Monday 9am' beats 'we'll get back to you soon.'

slides.heading: Offer **Two Slots**
slides.body: Let them pick a viewing time now, while they're still keen.

slides.heading: The **Script**
bullets: Hi, Kofi here. Thanks for messaging!

slides.heading: Confirm On **Monday**
slides.body: Reply first thing. Confirm the slot and send the location pin.

caption:
A weekend auto-reply can still book the viewing.

Use your name, not 'Your message has been received.'
Say exactly when you're back.
Offer two viewing slots so they can say yes right now.
On Monday, confirm the slot and send the location pin.
